en.headline: Police arrest 38-year-old man after finding drugs in reported stolen car in To Kwa Wan
en.dek: Officers discovered a previously reported missing private car on Chekiang Street on Thursday evening; a man who approached the vehicle was detained after officers found suspected cocaine inside.
body: Police arrested a 38-year-old man in To Kwa Wan on Thursday evening after locating a private car that had been reported stolen and finding a small quantity of suspected cocaine inside.

Officers from the Hung Hom division spotted the vehicle parked outside 31 Chekiang Street at about 6.38pm. Checks confirmed it matched a recent theft report. While officers were examining the car, a man approached and was stopped for questioning. He was unable to produce identification documents.

A subsequent search of the vehicle recovered 0.91 grams of suspected cocaine with an estimated street value of about HK$600. A police dog was later called to assist in a further check of the car. The man, surnamed Wong, was arrested on suspicion of failing to produce proof of identity, possession of a dangerous drug and taking a conveyance without authority. The case was handed to the Kowloon City District Crime Squad for investigation.

zh.headline: 土瓜灣浙江街發現報失私家車 警檢懷疑可卡因拘38歲男
zh.dek: 警員周四傍晚在浙江街發現一輛早前報失的私家車，其後一名男子走近車輛，被截查後未能出示身份證，車內檢獲約0.91克懷疑可卡因。
body: 警方周四晚上在土瓜灣浙江街發現一輛報失私家車，並於車內檢獲少量懷疑可卡因，拘捕一名38歲男子。
紅磡分區軍裝巡邏小隊約傍晚6時38分在浙江街31號對開發現該私家車，經查核證實早前有人報失。調查期間，一名男子走近車輛，警員上前截查，發現他未有攜帶身份證明文件。
其後在車內搜出0.91克懷疑可卡因，市值約600元。警方其後召緝毒犬到場協助搜車。該名姓黃男子涉嫌「未能出示身份證明文件」、「管有危險藥物」及「未獲授權而取用運輸工具」被捕，案件交由九龍城警區刑事調查隊第三隊跟進。
